messages:
julie: Heads-up: FinReg signed for a private on-prem pilot; they require HSM-backed keys, dedicated GPU pools, and strict network isolation. They want a Q3 pilot — can we map dependencies and gating? cc @alex @sam @li

alex: Runtime note: kernels ok, but we need persistent KV, a quant profile pinned, and a warmup hook to avoid first-request spikes.

sam: Infra: Dedicated pools possible but we need 2 racks in their colo region, NIC tagging for isolation, and service-account whitelisting. Procurement + capacity ~4w if ordered now.

li: Security: HSM integration + audit-log ingestion are hard blockers. Will require threat model, KMS rotation policy, and offline key import SOP.

maria: Product: Minimum launch criteria? Customer requires 99ms p50 for chat_api, data-at-rest encryption, canary + rollback plan.

alex: Quick config sketch:
```
cache:
  kv_persist: true
  warmup_keys: /etc/kv/warmup.txt
runtime:
  quant_profile: q4_2_v2
```
We also need a schema migration for KV persistence (small) and a 2-hour maintenance window.

sam: Networking: IP allowlist + VLAN tagging + BGP for colo. Ops needs maintenance playbook and DR runbook. Rack procurement is main blocker; proposal: use partner colo for pilot to shorten lead time.

li: Gating: infra/config automated scans and audit-log ingestion test must pass before canary. I'll add pass/fail criteria to the ticket.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: INF-4921 — "FinReg private on-prem pilot: infra+runtime+security integration" (assignee: unassigned) :ticket:

maria: Customer wants canary rollout: 1% traffic x48h, then 10% x72h, then ramp to 100% if no regressions. Document rollback window.

julie: Owners: Alex (runtime), Sam (infra), Li (security), Maria (customer stakeholder). Target pilot week: 3078200000 (~mid-Q3). Any blockers, call them out.

alex: I'll draft runtime/integration section by EOD Wed and attach KV migration patch to INF-4921. QA: simulate warmup traffic and verify p50 under load.

sam: I'll explore partner colo and estimate timeline/pricing delta. Ops will produce maintenance + DR runbooks.

li: I'll produce threat model + acceptance tests and add security signoff checklist to the ticket.

devex-bot: Runbook template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/finreg-onprem-template — ready for PR.

maria: Scheduling cross-team sync: 14:00 Wed. Action: owners update INF-4921 with docs/owners/timeline by COB tomorrow.

julie: Thanks — owners update ticket by COB tomorrow. If anything blocks earlier, ping @julie and we'll triage.
